name: claude-skills

plugins.name: claude-skills

plugins.name: design-craft
plugins.description: Design craft — a separate plugin that locks a visual direction, then builds and reviews interfaces with a senior design engineer’s taste: hierarchy, typography, color, surfaces, motion, copy, accessibility, landing pages, variants, stress tests and evidence-based review.
